sources: https://reserve.floridastateparks.org/Web/#!park/69 (US eDirect API floridardr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 69, search/grid + search/details for every unit of facilities 188 Canebreak, 189 Gopher and 191 Suwannee, start date 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-21)

values.note: $27 a night for an RV: the $20 campsite fee plus Florida's $7 nightly utility fee for RVs (tent campers pay $20), plus tax and a $6.70 reservation fee per reservation. No out-of-state rate; Florida residents 65 and over get half off the campsite fee.

fees.source: Reserve Florida search/details for every unit of facilities 188, 189, 191 (all 39 'RV or Tent' units Rate 20.00, Fee 6.70), read 2026-10-21 + https://www.floridastateparks.org/fees ($7 nightly RV utility fee, as read 2026-10-12)

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/stephen-foster-folk-culture-center-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('45 oak-shaded sites with electricity, water, picnic table and fire ring') + Reserve Florida search/details (Electric Hookup 30 on 35 units, 50 on 4 Canebreak units; Water Hookup on all; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park says 45 sites; Reserve Florida lists 39 'RV or Tent' units across the Canebreak, Gopher and Suwannee loops, 13 of them pull-through, lengths 30-100 ft.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/stephen-foster-folk-culture-center-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('the campground offers 45 oak-shaded sites'; 'Maximum RV length = 100 feet') + Reserve Florida search/grid + search/details (PullInTypeName, VehicleLength), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/stephen-foster-folk-culture-center-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Two ADA accessible restrooms with showers are located within the campground. A dump station is available.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/stephen-foster-folk-culture-center-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521'), read 2026-10-21

note: Oak-shaded sites near the Suwannee River, within walking distance of the Stephen Foster museum and carillon tower. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: $27 RV ($20 + $7 utility), $6.70 reservation fee, 45 sites with water + electric (50-amp at 4), max RV 100 ft, pull-throughs, showers, dump, reservable on Reserve Florida. The note's 'full-hookup' was wrong (water/electric only, no sewer); note reduced to setting. Not stated: booking window, FCFS, season.
flags: Phone missing: the park office is 386-397-4331 (floridastateparks.org park page).
